options.title: Forbes counted {fact2} billionaires. Split it all: how much is yours? 💸
options.first_line: Forbes counted {fact2} billionaires this year. Share out everything they own, and how much lands in your hand?
options.first_frame: A packed billionaires' gala lit gold, a giant FORBES 2026 scoreboard over the stage reading the billionaire count, and Rohan in the doorway holding out an empty palm.

options.title: Elon Musk and every billionaire, shared with you: how much each? 💸
options.first_line: Take Elon Musk's money, and every other billionaire's, and hand it to every person alive. How much is yours?
options.first_frame: A huge mountain of gold coins on a planet's horizon labelled ALL BILLIONAIRES, with a tiny Rohan at its foot holding up a cup.

options.title: All the world's billionaires' money, split with {fact4} people: your cut? 💸
options.first_line: Every billionaire's money, split between {fact4} people. So what would you get?
options.first_frame: Earth from space with a glowing population counter ticking over it, a vault door drawn on the globe swinging open.

why: It names the one billionaire everyone knows and asks a question about the viewer's own cut with no figure given away, and its first frame (a coin mountain labelled ALL BILLIONAIRES, tiny Rohan holding a cup) reads without sound.
